title: Tokmanni
meta_description: Tokmanni App brings a new level of benefits to our Klubi Members.
full_description: The Tokmanni App brings a new level of benefits to our Klubi Members, the customers who are closest to us.Through the app, our members get exclusive offers which they can redeem in shops, use the App to identify at the checkout counters and keep in touch with latest news from Tokmanni and make it easy to check the receipts from previous shopping tours.Whilst this is just a first phase for engaging our members via the App too, this will already enable our customers to get extra benefits whilst on the move.More info to come on www.tokmanni.fi.
